title: Crazy Crowd Brawl
description: Recruit a growing gang across chaotic urban arenas, outnumber rival squads, smash into brawls with hilarious physics, and dominate the entire street map.
controls: Drag on screen to steer your squad around the arena, absorb neutral fighters, and overwhelm smaller enemy groups.

zh-CN.title: 疯狂打群架
zh-CN.description: 魔性爆笑 3D 街头打群架：四处招兵买马壮大你的小弟军团，见人就干以多打少横扫全场成为街头最强老大！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕拖动控制队伍走位，收编散落队友壮大阵营，围攻并击败场上所有对手。
